earlier.claim: One handoff with bad front matter (YAML that does not parse, or generated that is not a mapping) crashes kmctl handoffs with a traceback, so /continue gets no list at all. The CLI rule says a refusal is one line on stderr naming the file and the fix, and no test covers this path.

as_datetime keeps a non-UTC offset instead of converting it, so its docstring ("an aware UTC datetime") is false, and _date_text labels the local time with Z. generated.at 2026-10-03T09:00:00+02:00 prints as 2026-10-03T09:00:00Z, two hours off.

new.claim: the new astimezone(UTC) call raises OverflowError for a datetime at the edge of the range, such as 0001-01-01T00:00:00+01:00, and the command crashes with a traceback
